author: Sandra
text: Highly recommend Jones Septic Service! They were able to fit me in last minute on a Saturday morning for a septic pump-out, which I really appreciated. He showed up right away and took the time to explain everything to me, being a first time home owner. Great customer service and honest work! I wouldn’t hesitate to use him again. I am now a Jones septic customer for life ! Thanks again Jones septic!

author: Pam Mccarver
text: Jones is very reasonable and reputable,He checks for any problems,which we had a minor one. So he saved us $$ down the line as could of been a bigger problem.He recommended a guy who came promptly and fixed our problem.

author: Terry Campbell
text: Jones Septic Service was excellent. We have a second home in the Elkton area and we’re in need of a pump out on our tank. Called them on a Friday and they were here early on Saturday morning to do the job in a clean and efficient manner. Price was very fair and the fact that they fit our schedule was amazing

author: critch170
text: I’ve been a customer of Jones Septic for years.  Always on time, professional, friendly, and takes the time to answer all questions and concerns about my convoluted filtration and pump system.

author: Kyle Jordan
text: Jones Septic Service is a fantastic family business. When I needed a quick tank pump so that I could do some repairs, I was able to reach them after hours, and they squeezed me in their schedule the very next morning. I was able to take my time with the repair work knowing I had an empty tank. I highly recommend them.
